Save {fact, provenance (required), `entity` (subject; recall needs it)} or items[]. Branch on `status`; write_pending: poll get_write_request.

text:
I saved it in gbrain: your sister's new cat is Skitrunum. A search for "Skitrunum" finds it.

gbrain filed it under your sister (`user-s-sister`) with the note "user stated in conversation, 2026-11-18". I accidentally saved it under the "preference" category instead of a plain fact. I tried to change that, but gbrain saw the same sentence and kept the original. That label doesn't change what you get back when you look it up.

Until gbrain is connected to Hermes (the config step from before), I can only look it up with the `gbrain recall` command, not automatically in new sessions.
